question: What is the meaning of environmental impacts in relation to life-cycle data?
description: Environmental impacts refer to the effects of a product or process on the environment throughout its life cycle, such as resource depletion, pollution, and climate change. These impacts are quantified and analyzed using life-cycle assessment (LCA) data, which provides a standardized set of information that can be linked to materials passports. However, due to the lack of broad consensus and harmonization in the LCA community, there is no clear guidance on how to include health effects in the calculations. Therefore, many LCA practitioners exclude toxicity-related impacts. The available LCA databases and indicators, such as those shown in figures 23 and 24, provide a comprehensive overview of the types of environmental impacts that can be analyzed using LCA data.
